# @alcspower/ui

> Accessible, reusable React component library (59+ components) built on Radix UI, Tailwind CSS v4 tokens, and CVA. Self-contained bundle with zero sub-dependencies.

- Package: `@alcspower/ui`
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@alcspower/ui
- Repository: https://github.com/AlcsPower/alcs-ui
- License: MIT
- Style: Modern SaaS / Craft Minimalist / Elevated Flat

## System Prompt Guidelines for AI Agents

When authoring code with `@alcspower/ui`, follow these strict rules:

1. **Imports:** Always import components, utilities, and toast directly from `'@alcspower/ui'`.
   ```tsx
   import { Button, Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent, Input, Field, Label, toast } from '@alcspower/ui';
   ```
2. **Global CSS:** Ensure `@alcspower/ui/styles.css` is imported in the application root (`main.tsx` or `App.tsx`).
   ```tsx
   import '@alcspower/ui/styles.css';
   ```
3. **Design Tokens:** NEVER use raw hex values (`#3b82f6`) or generic color classes (`bg-blue-600`, `text-gray-900`). Exclusively use semantic classes:
   - Backgrounds: `bg-alcspower-background`, `bg-alcspower-surface`, `bg-alcspower-surface-muted`, `bg-alcspower-primary`, `bg-alcspower-destructive`
   - Foregrounds: `text-alcspower-foreground`, `text-alcspower-muted-foreground`, `text-alcspower-primary`
   - Borders: `border-alcspower-border`, `border-alcspower-border-strong`
   - Focus: `focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-alcspower-primary/20`
4. **Class Merging:** Always use `cn()` from `'@alcspower/ui'` to merge Tailwind classes safely.
5. **Polymorphic Rendering:** Use `asChild` to wrap custom elements or router links (`<Link asChild>`).
6. **Toast Notifications:** Insert `<Toaster position="bottom-right" richColors />` once at the app root, then call `toast.success('...')`, `toast.error('...')`.

---

## Machine-Readable Manifest & Snippets

- Manifest: `registry.json` or `import manifest from '@alcspower/ui/registry.json'`
- VS Code Snippets: Available in `@alcspower/ui/snippets` (`.vscode/alcspower.code-snippets`)
- Quick AI summary: `llms-small.txt`

---

## Component Catalog & Recipes

### 1. Forms & Inputs

- **Button**:
  Variants: `primary`, `secondary`, `outline`, `ghost`, `destructive`, `link`
  Sizes: `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `icon`, `icon-sm`, `icon-lg`
  Props: `asChild?: boolean`, `isLoading?: boolean`, `loadingText?: string`
  ```tsx
  <Button variant="primary" size="md" isLoading={loading}>Guardar</Button>
  ```

- **Field (Compound Pattern)**:
  Components: `Field`, `Label`, `FieldDescription`, `FieldError`
  ```tsx
  <Field id="username" required>
    <Label>Nombre de Usuario</Label>
    <Input placeholder="admin" value={user} onChange={(e) => setUser(e.target.value)} />
    <FieldDescription>Nombre visible en el sistema.</FieldDescription>
    {error && <FieldError>{error}</FieldError>}
  </Field>
  ```

- **Select**:
  Components: `Select`, `SelectTrigger`, `SelectValue`, `SelectContent`, `SelectItem`, `SelectGroup`, `SelectLabel`
  ```tsx
  <Select value={val} onValueChange={setVal}>
    <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="Seleccione..." /></SelectTrigger>
    <SelectContent>
      <SelectItem value="active">Activo</SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="inactive">Inactivo</SelectItem>
    </SelectContent>
  </Select>
  ```

- **Additional Form Controls**:
  `Input`, `SearchInput`, `PasswordInput`, `NumberInput`, `OTPInput`, `Textarea`, `Checkbox`, `Switch`, `RadioGroup` (`RadioGroupItem`), `Slider`, `Toggle`, `ToggleGroup`, `Combobox`, `MultiSelect`, `TagsInput`, `FileUpload`.

### 2. Data Display & Metrics

- **Card (Compound Pattern)**:
  Components: `Card`, `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardContent`, `CardFooter`
  ```tsx
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Resumen Operativo</CardTitle>
      <CardDescription>Métricas acumuladas del periodo.</CardDescription>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardContent>...</CardContent>
    <CardFooter><Button variant="outline">Ver más</Button></CardFooter>
  </Card>
  ```

- **StatusBadge**:
  Props: `status: 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'info' | 'neutral'`
  ```tsx
  <StatusBadge status="success">Aprobado</StatusBadge>
  ```

- **Badge**:
  Variants: `primary`, `secondary`, `outline`, `destructive`, `success`, `warning`, `info`
  ```tsx
  <Badge variant="info">Nuevo</Badge>
  ```

- **Table & DataTable**:
  Primitivas: `Table`, `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableFooter`, `TableHead`, `TableRow`, `TableCell`, `TableCaption`
  DataTable avanzada: `<DataTable columns={columns} data={data} searchKey="nombre" />`

- **Metrics & KPIs**:
  Components: `MetricCard`, `StatCard`, `DeltaIndicator`
  ```tsx
  <MetricCard title="Ingresos" value="$45,200" delta="+8.4%" trend="positive" />
  ```

- **Charts**:
  Built on Recharts: `Chart` (Bar, Line, Area, Pie) with accessible container and responsive tokens.

### 3. Overlays & Modals

- **Dialog**:
  Components: `Dialog`, `DialogTrigger`, `DialogContent`, `DialogHeader`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, `DialogFooter`, `DialogClose`
  ```tsx
  <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
    <DialogTrigger asChild><Button>Editar</Button></DialogTrigger>
    <DialogContent>
      <DialogHeader>
        <DialogTitle>Editar Perfil</DialogTitle>
        <DialogDescription>Actualice sus datos personales.</DialogDescription>
      </DialogHeader>
      <div className="py-2">...</div>
      <DialogFooter>
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancelar</Button>
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleSave}>Guardar</Button>
      </DialogFooter>
    </DialogContent>
  </Dialog>
  ```

- **AlertDialog**:
  Components: `AlertDialog`, `AlertDialogTrigger`, `AlertDialogContent`, `AlertDialogHeader`, `AlertDialogTitle`, `AlertDialogDescription`, `AlertDialogFooter`, `AlertDialogAction`, `AlertDialogCancel`

- **Sheet & Drawer**:
  Props: `side: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'` (default `'right'`)

- **DropdownMenu & ContextMenu**:
  Subcomponents: `DropdownMenuTrigger`, `DropdownMenuContent`, `DropdownMenuItem`, `DropdownMenuSeparator`, `DropdownMenuLabel`

- **Command & CommandDialog**:
  Quick search palette (`CommandInput`, `CommandList`, `CommandEmpty`, `CommandGroup`, `CommandItem`).

### 4. Feedback & Navigation

- **Alert**:
  Variants: `default`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `destructive`
  ```tsx
  <Alert variant="warning">
    <AlertTitle>Atención requerida</AlertTitle>
    <AlertDescription>Su sesión expirará pronto.</AlertDescription>
  </Alert>
  ```

- **Toaster & toast**:
  ```tsx
  // In root:
  <Toaster position="bottom-right" richColors />

  // Anywhere in code:
  toast.success('Operación completada con éxito');
  toast.error('Ocurrió un error al procesar la solicitud');
  ```

- **Tabs**:
  `Tabs`, `TabsList`, `TabsTrigger`, `TabsContent`

- **Accordion**:
  `Accordion`, `AccordionItem`, `AccordionTrigger`, `AccordionContent` (type: `'single' | 'multiple'`)

- **EmptyState & ErrorState**:
  Accessible fallback components for lists, search results, and query failures.

- **Time Components**:
  `Calendar`, `DatePicker`, `DateRangePicker`

---

## CLI & Scaffolding

To install rules and snippets automatically in a consumer project:
```bash
npx @alcspower/ui init-agent
```
Supported agent integrations:
- Cursor (`.cursor/rules/alcspower-ui.mdc`)
- Claude Code (`CLAUDE.md`)
- GitHub Copilot (`.github/copilot-instructions.md`)
- Antigravity / Agentic IDEs (`.agent/skills/alcspower-ui/SKILL.md`)
- VS Code Snippets (`.vscode/alcspower.code-snippets`)
